text:
kai: Heads-up — midweek grind: pool-A (multiplexed) hit p90 saturation during APAC evening window. Seeing ~92% GPU util, p90 latency drifted. Can we triage quick mitigations and root causes? :eyes:
maria: Which routes/models are driving it? any sudden model-mix change?
ajay: Quick breakdown from the live slicer (last 15m):
```
pool-A:
  p90_latency: 238ms
  tokens_per_sec: 42k
  concurrent_reqs: 1.8k
  gpu_util: 92%
model_mix:
  redwood-3-small: 53%
  redwood-4-medium: 29%
  embeddings: 18%
avg_seq_len: 216
burst_tail: ~7% requests >1000 tokens
```
ajay: Notable: a small set of long-seq recommenders (campaign test) drove most of the tail. Multiplexing keeps throughput but increases token pressure and KV cache churn.
sre-bot: autoscaler: attempted scale +2 nodes at 1769999978 but throttled due to cooldown window (cooldown=300s). No manual override.
olivia: Can we quick-route long-seq traffic to a dedicated high-memory slice (pool-B) for the next 20m? That would reduce KV churn on pool-A. Tradeoff: small latency/regional hit for APAC users.
tim: Also worth flipping mux-batching for the heavy routes to smaller batch size (from 64->32) to reduce p90. Cost will go up ~12% for those requests.
devops: If we shift ~7% of request load (the long tail) to pool-B, estimated util change: pool-A gpu_util -> ~84%, pool-B add 0.6 GPUs equivalent. Quick sim command I ran: `scripts/sim-headroom --pool pool-A --shift 0.07 --batch-size 32` output: `headroom +8.1% p90 -42ms`.
maria: Are there networking hiccups? any inter-region egress spikes?
ajay: No egregious egress; network p95 stable. PCIe stalls slightly higher on 1 host (dmesg shows a WARN) — flagged host-17 for infra.
kai: So short plan: 1) devops/push: shift tail routes to pool-B for 20m (olivia + devops). 2) tim: deploy smaller batch override for the flagged routes. 3) infra: replace/evict host-17 if PCIe errors persist (ajay). 4) increase autoscaler aggressiveness for the evening window (sre team to discuss cooldown settings).
olivia: I'll open a quick canary route and publish a manual reroute (~2m to roll).
sre-bot: reminder: scaling cooldown change requires runbook + postmortem if we hit double-scale churn.
kai: Perfect — let's reconvene in 25m. If anyone sees p95 > 500ms, ping here and @oncall. :thumbsup:
